detail.longDescription:
From the developer of the Award Winning Conversion Calculator App, "Mila's Tools", comes "Scott's Pinger" - an elegant, no frills, easy-to-use website status and up-time monitor. 

- - - - 

Monitor your websites, APIs, and services in real time. Scott's Pinger checks your URLs on a configurable schedule and gives you instant visibility into uptime, response speed, and performance — right from your iPhone.

Know the moment something goes wrong. Get push notifications when a site goes down and when it recovers. View detailed response times, HTTP status codes, and performance analysis for every check.

FREE FEATURES • Monitor unlimited URLs from your device • Real-time status: Good, Slow, or Failed • Response time measurement (time to first byte) • Configurable check intervals (30s, 1m, 2m, 5m) • 24-hour on-device check history • Performance gauge with speed analysis • Actionable performance and security tips • Multiple themes including dark mode • Works with HTTP and HTTPS URLs • Runs on iPhone

PLUS — 24/7 CLOUD MONITORING • 25 cloud-monitored URLs • Checks every 15 minutes, around the clock • Push notifications on failure and recovery • 30-day check history • Monitoring continues when the app is closed

PRO — MAXIMUM COVERAGE • 100 cloud-monitored URLs • Checks as often as every 1 minute • Push notifications on failure and recovery • 1-year check history • Everything in Plus, scaled up

HOW IT WORKS Add any URL — your website, API endpoint, staging server, or any HTTP/HTTPS address. Scott's Pinger measures time to first byte for each check, giving you accurate response time data without downloading full page content.

The performance gauge gives you an at-a-glance speed rating with a detailed breakdown of DNS lookup, TCP connection, TLS handshake, and server processing time. Built-in tips analyze your results and suggest concrete improvements.

With a Plus or Pro subscription, your monitors are checked 24/7 from the cloud — even when your phone is in your pocket. Get instant push alerts the moment a site fails, and again when it recovers.

Whether you're a developer keeping tabs on production, a freelancer watching client sites, or just someone who wants to know when their blog goes down — Scott's Pinger has you covered.

Privacy first: local data stays on your device. Cloud monitoring data is stored securely and tied to your anonymous account. No sign-up required.

- - - - -

If there's a specific option or feature you'd like to see added, please write me at http://bit.ly/WriteScottDeSapio, and I'll see about getting it into the next release. Thanks!
